description: This file contains React component tests for the mobile navigation bar, including mocking IntersectionObserver, simulating user interactions like toggling menu visibility, and verifying accessibility attributes and class changes.

classes.name: IO
classes.description: A mock implementation of IntersectionObserver to control intersection observations during tests.

methods.name: observe
methods.description: Adds an element to the set of observed elements and triggers the callback immediately with isIntersecting false.

methods.name: unobserve
methods.description: Removes an element from the observed set.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Clears the set of observed elements.

methods.name: takeRecords
methods.description: Returns an empty array, simulating no recorded intersection entries.
